text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 13, 2025) for 25 Cosburn Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 13, 2025) for 25 Cosburn Avenue, Folder No. 25 253139 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to April 30, 2026.
